tow.text: The "stolen" Honda was towed for street sweeping. The owner is not happy with anyone.

options.text: Give her the tow yard's number.

car.text: The stolen car is parked behind a laundromat, engine running, two men inside.

options.text: High-risk stop: commands from behind your doors.
Box it in with the patrol car.

car_out.text: Both men come out with their hands up. The driver keeps glancing at the floorboard.

options.text: Cuff both and search the car.

success.note: A baggie of Spark under the seat. Two in custody.

options.text: Cuff the driver, let the passenger sit on the curb.
